query:
SELECT ar.cliente, LEFT(ar.vencimentoData, 10) as venc, COUNT(*) as cnt, 
  GROUP_CONCAT(ar.valorLiquido) as valores
FROM accounts_receivable ar
WHERE ar.estado = 'EMITIDO' AND ar.vencimentoData <= NOW() 
AND ar.tipo IN ('TITULO', 'RECEITA', 'ADIANTAMENTO')
AND (CAST(ar.valorLiquido AS DECIMAL(18,2)) - CAST(COALESCE(ar.valorRecebidoLiquido, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2))) > 0
GROUP BY ar.cliente, LEFT(ar.vencimentoData, 10)
HAVING cnt > 1
ORDER BY cnt DESC;
